messages:
Jules: Heads-up — Foxtail popped back with a few clarifications on our draft RFI. They want a concise capability matrix (one page), explicit burst billing formula, and confirmation we can support FIPS-level HSM for Private. They asked for the RFI packet by COB Monday.
Marta: on it. Is there a preferred template for a one-page matrix? we usually do rows for "Feature/Compliance/Perf" and columns for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Omar: Yup. Use the slim matrix template we used for Helix (I put a copy in the sales drive). For perf numbers let's give conservative sustained and burst entries and call out that Private depends on infra.
Priya: Legal wants exact wording for BYOK and HSM support. We support Thales and AWS CloudHSM; for FIPS certs we can say "FIPS 140-2/3 compliant HSMs supported" and link to the Private deploy appendix. Also confirm our KMS rotation schedule (90d) and ability to configure customer rotation cadence in Private.
Jules: Good — also they asked for a billing formula for bursts. Can we propose: burst fee = base per-embedding * burst_multiplier * minutes_of_burst, where burst_multiplier = 2.5 and burst defined as QPS > commit for > 1 minute. Put a short example.
Omar: Draft snippet (drop-in):
```
Example: Customer commits 300 QPS. During a 5-minute burst to 1500 QPS, excess minutes billed: (1500-300)/300 = 4x overcommit => minutes_billed = 5; burst_multiplier = 2.5; burst_charge = base_rate * 4 * 5 * 2.5
```
Jules: Nice — concise. Marta can you map that into the one-page matrix and add a tiny footnote about autoscale smoothing window (30s) and graceful throttle policy?
Marta: yep. I'll add the matrix and a single-line note on throttling. Linking draft: https://drive.redwood/foxtail/onepager_matrix_draft.xlsx 
BenchBot: scheduled bench job foxtail-rfi-4781234567 started; expected results in 90m.
Priya: Also include a short sentence on encryption at rest: "Data at rest encrypted with AES-256; Private deployments can optionally leverage customer-managed keys in validated HSMs." I'll attach the encryption diagram once Legal signs off.
Jules: Action items: Marta — finalize matrix + footnote; Omar — polish the burst billing example (one-line formula and numeric example); Priya — attach BYOK wording and SOC2 snapshot; I'll assemble final packet and sign-off with Sales Ops before submission.
Marta: ETA for matrix update: today 4pm PT. I will notate quantization support (8-bit, 4-bit experimental) and any perf caveats.
Omar: After BenchBot posts results I'll update the perf row with p50/p95 p99 timings and a short note about batching assumptions.
Jules: Perfect. If anyone runs into blockers ping me. @Priya please flag any legal redlines ASAP.
Priya: Will do. Leaving a quick legal comment here: we cannot guarantee FIPS certification of third-party HSM hardware; we can state compatibility with FIPS-validated HSMs and provide vendor guidance.
Jules: Acknowledged. Thanks team :thumbsup: — will collect assets and submit Monday COB if all items land.
